title: Daily Market Briefing
text:
BOTTOM LINE — Hawkish repricing, metals crushed, megacap resilient.
Rate-hike odds jumped to 64% for October, driving silver -4.23% and gold -1.80% while oil +3.30% and the dollar +0.60% compounded the pain; SPY -0.72% with QQQ -0.84% outperforming small caps as breadth collapsed to 34% advancers. Flows confirm the defensive dump: SPY -$13,002mm (2nd percentile) and IWM -$3,320mm as the market prices a more aggressive Fed.

INDICES — VIX 14.2, and VIXY +1.88%. QQQ -0.84%, SPY -0.72%, DIA -0.71%, IJR -1.12%, SOXX -1.23%, IWM -1.84%. Large > small by 0.40pp. Most notable cross-asset: USO +3.30% on supply fears while SLV -4.23% got crushed by dollar strength and hike odds. No index is below its 200-DMA yet.

VOLUME & BREADTH — SPY vol_ratio 1.3x, QQQ 0.9x — SPY elevated on price down = distribution; QQQ below average with price down = apathy, not conviction selling. SOXX 1.4x on price -1.23% = distribution. Breadth is ugly: 34% advancers, 28% above 50-DMA, up/down vol 0.39, new 60d highs/lows 13/105. Participation diverges hard — the index holds but the tape is narrow and deteriorating.

SECTORS & ROTATION — XLI Industrials +0.00%, XLF Financials +0.00%, XLE Energy +0.00%, XLP Staples -0.36%, XLK Technology -0.47%, XLB Materials -0.49%, XLV Healthcare -0.64%, XLC Comms -0.85%, XLY Discretionary -1.50%, XLRE Real Estate -1.55%, XLU Utilities -1.92%. Top industries: USO +3.30%, MSOS +1.88%; bottom: GDX -4.36%, SILJ -5.44%. Flows: XLY +$711mm (100p) and XLK +$147mm (60p) led inflows; XLF -$2,305mm (0p) and XLV -$1,089mm (2p) bled hardest. Money moved into discretionary and tech but fled financials and healthcare — utilities sank -1.92% on rate fear. Defensive risk-off.

POSITIONING — SPY PCR 1.13 and QQQ PCR 1.27 = elevated protection demand; skew positive (SPY +3.8%, QQQ +6.3%) confirms put premium. VIX 14.2 below its 20-day MA (15.6) = index complacency. VIXEQ 39.2 vs VIX 14.2 — the 25-point gap signals extreme single-stock dispersion and rotation, not macro correlation.

CROSS-ASSET — Dollar +0.60% crushing silver -4.23% (SLV PCR 0.43, IV 31.4%) and gold -1.80% — the hike repricing is the transmission chain. Next FOMC Oct 28: CME FedWatch hike 100%, Polymarket pricing 64% for a 25bp hike (up 10pp in 5 days).

SIGNALS & WATCH — Fear & Greed 51.6, Neutral. Movers: PANW +5.00%, WPM -5.44%, PAAS -5.39%. Vol spikes: UNG 2.8x (flat price = no signal), FNGS 2.2x (flat = consolidation). Momentum extremes: XLK best 20d +7.48%, XLU worst -8.22%. Watch WPM -5.44% (silver rout, momentum break), SLV -4.23% (PCR 0.43, IV 31.4% — bearish vol bid), and XLRE -1.55% on 1.3x volume (rate sensitivity).
